20261119-chemistry-h3.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4 ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261119-chemistry-h3.material: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. Yintoni umthetho wesantya kunye ne-overall reaction order yale ntsabela?
20261119-chemistry-h3.s.s1.prompt: Kuvavanyo lwezantya zokuqala lwentsabela 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), xa [O₂] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [NO] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-4, kwaye xa [NO] yagcinwa ingatshintshi kwaye [O₂] yaphindwa kabini, isantya saba kuphindwa ka-2. 20261119-chemistry-h3.s.s1.explain: Xa $[\text{NO}]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$4$, ngoko $m=2$, kwaye xa $[\text{O}_2]$ iphindwa ka-$2$ isantya siba kuphindwa ka-$2$, ngoko $n=1$. Umthetho wesantya yi-$v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, kwaye i-overall reaction order yi-$2 + 1 = 3$.

20261121-chemistry-h3-1.title: N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0)
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0) ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.material: Intsabela ye-exothermic yegesi elandelayo ikwi-dynamic equilibrium kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0).  Zeziphi iimeko ekufuneka zilungiswe ukwandisa isivuno se-ammonia (NH₃) kwi-equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: Intsabela ye-exothermic yegesi elandelayo ikwi-dynamic equilibrium kwisikhongozeli esivaliweyo:  N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g) + ubushushu (ΔH < 0).  Zeziphi iimeko ekufuneka zilungiswe ukwandisa isivuno se-ammonia (NH₃) kwi-equilibrium?
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Kuba intsabela i-exothermic ($\Delta H < 0$), ubushushu kufuneka buhliswe ukuze intsabela ebheke phambili, ekhupha ubushushu, ibe ngaphezulu. Kwakhona, kuba iimoli zegesi zehla zisuka ku-$4\text{ mol} \rightarrow 2\text{ mol}$, uxinzelelo kufuneka lunyuswe ukuze i-equilibrium ibhekise kwintsabela ebheke phambili, ehlisa inani leemolekyuli.
20261121-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.hint.1: Kuba intsabela i-exothermic, ukwehlisa ubushushu kuyibhekisa kwintsabela ebheke phambili, ekhupha ubushushu. Izisabelayo zii-4 mol → imveliso ii-2 mol, ngoko ukunyusa uxinzelelo kuyibhekisa kwintsabela ebheke phambili, ene-mol ezimbalwa.

20261122-chemistry-h3-1.title: Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.material: [Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo] Sesiphi isikhetho esiqulathe zonke kuphela izitatimenti ezichanekileyo ngeempawu (colligative properties) zesisombululo esifakwe amanzi esine-solute engatshabalaliyo, engekho-electrolyte? (i) Zilingana kuphela nenani lezinto ezincinci ze-solute (molality), nokuba luhlobo luni lwe-solute. (ii) Uxinzelelo lomphunga luyehla kwaye indawo yokubila iyanyuka xa kuthelekiswa ne-solvent ecocekileyo. (iii) Ifomula ye-osmotic pressure ka-van 't Hoff, Π = cRT, ifana ne-ideal gas equation of state.
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.prompt: [Iimpawu ze-colligative ezi-advanced zezisombululo] Sesiphi isikhetho esiqulathe zonke kuphela izitatimenti ezichanekileyo ngeempawu (colligative properties) zesisombululo esifakwe amanzi esine-solute engatshabalaliyo, engekho-electrolyte? (ii) Uxinzelelo lomphunga luyehla kwaye indawo yokubila iyanyuka xa kuthelekiswa ne-solvent ecocekileyo. (iii) Ifomula ye-osmotic pressure ka-van 't Hoff, Π = cRT, ifana ne-ideal gas equation of state.
20261122-chemistry-h3-1.s.s1.explain: Iimpawu ze-colligative zesisombululo zixhomekeke kuphela kwinani lezinto ezincinci, nokuba luhlobo luni lwe-solute, kwaye zibandakanya ukwehla koxinzelelo lomphunga, ukunyuka kwendawo yokubila, ukwehla kwendawo yokukhenkceza, kunye ne-osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), ngoko (i), (ii), kunye ne-(iii) zonke zichanekile.

20261122-chemistry-h3-2.title: efufa i-airbag kwi-0
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-efufa i-airbag kwi-0 ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.material: Ukulinganisa ukubola kwe-sodium azide eqinileyo (NaN₃), efufa i-airbag kwi-0.03 yeesekhondi kwingozi yemoto, kunjalo 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Yintoni isizathu sekhemikhali esifanelekileyo kakhulu sokusetyenziswa kwale ntsabela ukwenza igesi ye-airbag?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.prompt: Ukulinganisa ukubola kwe-sodium azide eqinileyo (NaN₃), efufa i-airbag kwi-0.03 yeesekhondi kwingozi yemoto, kunjalo 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Yintoni isizathu sekhemikhali esifanelekileyo kakhulu sokusetyenziswa kwale ntsabela ukwenza igesi ye-airbag?
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.explain: Xa kukho i-spark yombane, i-sodium azide ibola ngokukhawuleza kwaye ivelisa isixa esikhulu segesi ye-nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$), engenabungozi emzimbeni womntu kwaye ingasebenzi kwikhemikhali, ikhusela ngokukhuselekileyo abakhweli kwingozi.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.0: Igesi ye-nitrogen (N₂) yenza i-78% yomoya kwaye ayinabungozi emzimbeni womntu kwaye ayitshi.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.hint.1: I-2 mol eqinileyo ngoko nangoko iyandiswa ibe yi-3 mol yegesi.
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o0: Isixa esincinci esiqinileyo sisabela ukuvelisa isixa esikhulu segesi ye-nitrogen (N₂) ekhuselekileyo kakhulu, ezinzileyo, engasebenziyo ngesantya esigqabhukayo
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o1: Ivelisa igesi ye-chlorine enetyhefu ecoca umoya
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o2: Intsabela iyabanda ukuya kwi-50 degrees ngaphantsi kwe-zero
20261122-chemistry-h3-2.s.s1.o.o3: Akukho gesi eyenziweyo kwaye iyabelana ibe yisiponji eqinileyo
